**On the Deﬁnitions of Diﬀerence Galois Groups**

*Zoé Chatzidakis∗, Charlotte Hardouin, Michael F. Singer†*

31 pp, 10 sections.

**Abstract.** We compare several deﬁnitions of the Galois group of a linear diﬀerence equation that have arisen in algebra, analysis and model theory and show, that these groups are isomorphic over suitable ﬁelds. In addition, we study properties of Picard-Vessiot extensions over ﬁelds with not necessarily algebraically closed subﬁelds of constants.

**Outline.** Front matter; Introduction; A Ring-Theoretic Point of View; A Tannakian Point of View; Comparison of the Galois groups; A Model-Theoretic Point of View; Preliminary model-theoretic definitions and re; The Galois group; More on Picard-Vessiot rings; Concluding remarks
